article.title: Cliopatria: a dataset of world-wide polities from 3400 BCE to 2024 CE
relevant_statements: 508 hand-created map images each associated with a specific, irregularly sampled year
source references organized by modern-state region in Table 1
specialized regional sources consulted to confirm/resolve changes and plausible mutually consistent borders
approximate boundaries; border uncertainty and territorial disputes not encoded
occupation and treaties may change borders within polity lifetimes
the single data file has one or more records per entity and row interval

period_semantics.source_fields: FromYear and ToYear are inclusive in upstream README/paper
period_semantics.local_representation: App index preserves source_from/source_to and uses half-open valid_from/valid_to for normalization

selection.method: OGR spatial filter against exact pinned GeoJSON, source year interval intersects 1800–1820 inclusive, exact Name Kingdom of Spain or Kingdom of Portugal; retain first 10 in upstream feature order. Window only aids sample retrieval; no new boundary is created.
selection.source_fid: OGR GeoJSON driver FID assigned in zero-based feature order for this exact archive; raw GeoJSON has no explicit feature id property. Treat identity as archive hash + FID + attributes; not portable across version changes.

limitations: Article Table 1 lists Spain references by region, not by individual GeoJSON feature or map-year; there is no row-level citation key in the pinned GeoJSON properties.
The SeshatID pages listed by the article returned HTTP 403 in this review, so their detailed linked evidence was unavailable.
No cited reference in this bounded list resolves sovereignty/control/claim meaning feature by feature.
No direct treaties, local administrative records or alternative claimant maps were independently evaluated.
methods: Read current source inventory and existing data/cliopatria index/parts; did not recreate the source archive from scratch.
Downloaded exact index-pinned public ZIP and verified full SHA-256 equality.
Read original schema and queried at most ten matching records using GDAL spatial/time/name filters; no majority overlay, territory statistics, or geometry changes.
Inspected article/README/license, source map snapshots at selected years, and four Spain-region citations; retained source restoration hashes, access status and rights findings.
